news_cards.title: Cabinet Approves GOBARdhan Scheme for Compressed Biogas
bullets: Kendra sarkar ne GOBARdhan yojana ko mana, jiska udeshya compressed biogas ka utpaadan hai
Is yojana ke liye 23,731 crore rupee ka outlay hai, jo compressed biogas ke vikas mein madad karega
GOBARdhan yojana ke madhyam se kendra sarkar gareebon ko rojgar ke avsar pradaan karne ki koshish kar rahi hai

news_cards.title: Agni-4 Missile Ka Safal Pareekshan
bullets: Bharat ne Agni-4 missile ka safal pareekshan kiya, jo ek madhyam doori ki ballistic missile hai
Agni-4 missile ki maark kshamta 4000 kilometer hai, jo isey ek shaktishaali missile banati hai
Agni-4 missile ka vikas Bharat ke raksha anusandhan aur vikas sangathan (DRDO) dwara kiya gaya hai

news_cards.title: RBI Ne Loan Recovery Ke Naye Niyam Jari Kiye
bullets: RBI ne loan recovery ke naye niyam jari kiye, jiske tahat loan nahi chukaane par bankon ko kuchh vishesh adhikar diye gaye hain
Naye niyam ke tahat bankon ko loan recovery ke liye adhik kathor kadam uthane ki anumati di gayi hai
RBI ke is faisale se loan recovery mein sudhar aane ki ummeed hai

news_cards.title: BRICS Summit Ka Aayojan
bullets: BRICS summit ka aayojan kiya gaya, jismein Bharat ne mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayi
Summit mein vishv ke mahatvapoorn mudde charche ke liye uthaye gaye
BRICS summit ke madhyam se Bharat ne apni vishvasthiti ko majboot banane ki koshish ki

news_cards.title: National Handloom Day Ka Aayojan
bullets: National Handloom Day ka aayojan kiya gaya, jismein hastshilp ko badhava dena tha
Is din ke avsar par hastshilp ko badhava dene ke liye kai karyakram aayojit kiye gaye
National Handloom Day ke madhyam se hastshilp ko badhava mila
